mentions.note: Scaled via acquisitions into top-tier defense; operates in communications, space, electronic warfare, ISR; owns Aerojet Rocketdyne (missile propulsion) acquired ~3 years ago—increasingly valuable as U.S. rebuilds missile stockpile; counter-drone products (Vampire System) in high demand.
Down-and-out defense name just landed a $6B federal contract under a new CEO; Cramer recommends scaling in incrementally from around $230.
